policy_metadata.policy_title: Laboratory – Parathyroid Hormone, Phosphorus, Calcium and Magnesium Testing

sections.heading: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
content: As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to this policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. • Serum intact parathyroid (PTH) testing (CPT code 83970*) IS REIMBURSABLE for individuals with any of the following conditions at the designated frequency: - As needed for individuals who have: ▪ The following signs of hypoparathyroidism: - Abnormal magnesium - Elevated serum phosphorus - Hypercalciuria - Hypocalcemia - Low calcitriol ▪ Abnormal calcium ▪ Familial medullary thyroid carcinoma ▪ Multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2A ▪ Osteoporosis or low bone mass ▪ Undergone parathyroidectomy - One test per year for individuals who have been diagnosed with hyperparathyroidism but who have not undergone parathyroidectomy - One test every 12 months for individuals who have been diagnosed with stage 3 chronic kidney disease (CKD) - One test every three months for individuals who have been diagnosed with stage 4 or stage 5 CKD - One test every three months for individuals who are younger than 18 years of age and who have been diagnosed with pseudohypoparathyroidism type 1A or type 1B, pseudopseudohypoparathyroidism, progressive osseous heteroplasia or acrodysostosis - One test per year for individuals who are 18 years of age or older and who have been diagnosed with pseudohypoparathyroidism type 1A or type 1B, pseudopseudohypoparathyroidism, progressive osseous heteroplasia or acrodysostosis Policy Number : LAB2023049 • The following tests ARE NOT REIMBURSABLE for individuals with a primary diagnosis representing a general encounter without abnormal findings: - Serum, blood or fecal magnesium testing (CPT code 83735**) - Serum ionized calcium (CPT code 82330) or urine calcium testing (CPT code 82340) - Urine phosphorus or phosphate testing (CPT code 84105) Applicable procedures for Medicare Advantage plans

sections.heading: Original Medicare Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs)
content: **The payment criterion for 83735 applies to all Medicare jurisdictions, except for Noridian Healthcare Solutions, LLC and Palmetto GBA.
